member.name: M:Microsoft.Extensions.Validation.ValidationsGenerator.EmitInfoClasses
member.summary: Emits the DisplayNameInfo and ValidatableInfo family (and the runtime parameter resolver) as file-local class bodies so they no longer need to ship from the Microsoft.Extensions.Validation assembly. The bodies are emitted directly inside the existing Microsoft.Extensions.Validation.Generated namespace block, alongside the generated resolver. Every type reference is fully qualified with global:: so the emitted code needs no using directives.

member.name: M:Microsoft.Extensions.Validation.ITypeSymbolExtensions.IsJsonIgnoredProperty(Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.IPropertySymbol,Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.INamedTypeSymbol)
member.summary: Checks if the property is marked with [JsonIgnore] attribute with a condition that affects deserialization. Only skips validation when the condition is Always or WhenReading, as these affect the reading/deserialization process. Properties with conditions that only affect writing (WhenWritingDefault, WhenWritingNull, WhenWriting) or Never are still validated.
